description: A floor-length dark green Battanian court gown over a cream linen underdress, with a low square neckline, opaque structured bodice, elbow sleeves and a fuller naturally fitted waist. Gold knotwork bands frame the neckline, waist, cuffs, front and hem. A large round knotwork clasp secures the woven belt, a plaid fringed wool shawl rests around the arms, and a small metal pendant necklace adds restrained ornament. Dark shoes appear beneath the modest walking opening.
